# AL1301: Avoid lock on 'this'

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Threading` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1300ToAl1303ThreadingAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Locking on 'this' exposes the lock object to external code. Any code with a reference to this instance can lock on it, potentially causing deadlocks. Use a private readonly object field instead.
